data.rationale: The proposal follows the true procedure in order with matching parameters (From/To autocomplete, date, passengers/cabin with Confirm, Show flights, Select fare for each leg); it only adds an optional Explore detour and a Continue click, and it leaves the choice of which fare to pick unparameterized, which makes it slightly less automatable.
